title: From Republic to Empire
tagline: The world changes as Rome changes.

approval.evidence: User directives in IRGS Campaign Design conversation; earlier drafted concept text.

public.period_label: Late Republic through imperial periods, scope to research
public.synopsis: A civilization-scale simulation follows social, economic, and political transformation across Roman and neighboring societies. Historical entry points are grounded, but subsequent player-influenced developments need not reproduce the documented transition. The empire, its communities, and its critics operate as autonomous institutions.

design.scope_statement: Multiple interacting civilization networks with continuous historical and individual state
design.core_3_3_verification: document_reference_only; runtime capability not certified by this catalogue
design.core_integration_policy: inherit Core; propose upstream changes by CMRR; do not replicate shared resource/state owners
design.player_agency_requirement: Do not invent player speech, thoughts, motives, travel, allegiance, or voluntary decisions.
design.persistent_state_requirement: Maintain coherent records of actors, knowledge, time, possessions, ownership, transit, work, and consequences.
